usage: sot-validator cert-report [-h] --fingerprints FINGERPRINTS [--snapshot SNAPSHOT]
                                 [--site-id SITE_ID] [--warn-days WARN_DAYS]
                                 [--evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME] [--output-json OUTPUT_JSON]
                                 [--output-md OUTPUT_MD]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --fingerprints FINGERPRINTS
                        RawServiceBanner JSON list or {"banners": [...]} with tls_certificates
                        (the fingerprint --banners format).
  --snapshot SNAPSHOT   Optional Site JSON snapshot file or SnapshotStore directory for site ID
                        and SoT hostnames.
  --site-id SITE_ID     Site ID to select from --snapshot, or to stamp on findings without one
                        (default: unknown).
  --warn-days WARN_DAYS
                        Comma-separated positive expiry warning thresholds in days (default:
                        90,60,30).
  --evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME
                        Reference ISO-8601 timestamp (naive means UTC; default: now).
  --output-json OUTPUT_JSON
                        Output path for the certificate report JSON.
  --output-md OUTPUT_MD
                        Output path for the certificate report Markdown.
